en_title: Gola Bazar Road Accident: Death Sparks Protest at Chand Chauraha
en_seo_title: Gola Bazar Road Accident: Death Sparks Protest at Chand Chauraha
en_body: A road construction incident near Chand Chauraha on Ram Janki Marg in Gola Bazar, Gorakhpur, has led to renewed concerns about safety around heavy machinery. Local reporting identifies the deceased as 45-year-old Chhangur Sonkar, who was injured in an incident involving a leveller machine and died during treatment on November 9, 2026. Following the death, family members and residents staged a road blockade demanding compensation. The demonstration reportedly lasted around one and a half hours. Police from nearby stations attended the scene, and officials including the sub-divisional magistrate and circle officer gave assurances after which the protest ended. The final compensation decision was not confirmed in the report. Road users should exercise caution around active construction sites, where machinery and pedestrian movement can overlap.
